description: Defines functions and classes for efficient string lookup in fixed sets using DAFSA (Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton). Includes lookup functions, a class for incremental prefix/suffix queries, and related constants.

classes.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
classes.description: Provides incremental, space-efficient membership and prefix queries against a fixed set of strings represented as a DAFSA.

methods.name: LookupStringInFixedSet
methods.description: Performs a fast lookup to determine if a string is in a fixed set, returning a bitmap of rules or not found.

methods.name: LookupSuffixInReversedSet
methods.description: Finds the longest matching suffix in a reversed DAFSA for a given host.

methods.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the incremental lookup with a DAFSA graph.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Adds a character to the current input sequence for prefix/suffix matching.

methods.name: GetResultForCurrentSequence
methods.description: Returns the result code for the current input sequence in the incremental lookup.
